threat_event: Support console access exposes college tenant records
threat_source: Attacker using a support account, or support insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing read access to the college tenant without college approval
treatment_plan: College approval of support access; review of support access logs each month (GR-01)

threat_event: Warehouse analysts access student and clinic records beyond any legitimate educational interest
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad schema roles; clinic utilization tables; no purpose tags
treatment_plan: Purge clinic tables; role redesign; purpose tags (POAM-005 to POAM-007)

threat_event: The college cannot assess or get timely notice from the Campus Platform as its service provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Intercompany agreement without safeguards terms
treatment_plan: Revised agreement; annual assessment (POAM-009)

threat_event: GLBA finding in the Title IV compliance audit
treatment_plan: Close High and Moderate P03 gaps before FY2026 audit fieldwork

threat_event: Ransomware at a legacy campus spreads to the integration hub and exfiltrates student data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat networks; legacy SIS; nightly loads to the hub
treatment_plan: Segment legacy campuses; retire legacy SIS by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Phishing of financial aid staff leads to FAMS or SAIG compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lures disguised as ISIR corrections and verification documents
existing_controls: Training; MFA; EDR on SAIG workstations
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant authenticators for financial aid staff

threat_event: Refund diverted through a student account takeover and bank detail change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes in student financials
treatment_plan: Fraud analytics on bank changes before refund runs

threat_event: Admissions applicant scoring disadvantages applicants by protected trait without notice or review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model in production since 2025 without bias testing, applicant notice, or human review rule; Colorado SB26-189 applies from 2027-01-01
regulatory_driver: Title VI; Section 504; Age Discrimination Act; Colo. SB26-189; N61-R02 (314.4(f))
existing_controls: Scores used only for outreach order
treatment_plan: Bias testing, notice, human review rule, Colorado readiness (POAM-022; P10)

threat_event: Student-success scores used to discourage enrollment or limit services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Advisor guidance incomplete; FAFSA-derived inputs
treatment_plan: Remove FAFSA-derived inputs; human review rule; monthly note sampling (P10)

threat_event: Admissions or enrollment staff account takeover exposes full student records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,900 staff with full-record SIS access
treatment_plan: Narrow admissions roles to admitted-student onboarding fields

threat_event: FAFSA-derived data used outside aid administration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FAFSA-derived fields copied to the warehouse without restriction
treatment_plan: Restrict FAFSA-derived fields to the financial aid role (POAM-007)

threat_event: FAMS vendor breach or outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single vendor for aid processing
treatment_plan: Exit plan and manual packaging procedure

threat_event: Proctoring vendor breach exposes exam video and identity images
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Biometric images and video retained by vendor
treatment_plan: Verify deletion each term

threat_event: Campus Platform outage with no standby for the college integration hub; end-to-end recovery untested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hub single region; no joint test
treatment_plan: Hub standby; joint failover test (POAM-008)

threat_event: Customer information kept beyond 2 years after last use
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warehouse keeps SIS extracts indefinitely
existing_controls: Records schedule for SIS and FAMS
treatment_plan: Warehouse retention rules and annual disposal (POAM-020)

threat_event: Privileged insider alters grades or transcripts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenant admin role
treatment_plan: Monthly grade change review by the registrar

threat_event: Integration hub static secret stolen and used to read the SIS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 static secrets older than 1 year
treatment_plan: Workload identity; 90-day rotation (POAM-002)

threat_event: Penetration testing misses the hub, warehouse, and legacy campuses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2026 test scoped to the tenant and portals
treatment_plan: Expand 2027 test scope (POAM-010)

threat_event: Campus emergency notification unavailable during an emergency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One vendor; campus network dependency
treatment_plan: Annual failover test
owner: College vice president of campus safety

threat_event: College misses the FSA immediate notice or FTC 30-day notice for a platform incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No notice clock from Education Software to the college
treatment_plan: 24-hour intercompany notice clock; tabletop (POAM-004, POAM-009)

threat_event: Shared local administrator password on legacy campus servers lets an attacker move laterally
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One local admin password on 31 servers (P07 finding)
treatment_plan: Unique rotated local admin passwords (POAM-011)

threat_event: Automated disclosures are missing from FERPA disclosure records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clearinghouse and proctoring disclosures not logged per student
treatment_plan: Automated disclosure logging in the SIS

threat_event: Annual FERPA notice does not describe outsourced school officials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notice silent on Education Software, Student Health, and AI vendors
treatment_plan: Update the notice (POAM-021)

threat_event: Compromise of student or lab Wi-Fi reaches staff systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared campus infrastructure
treatment_plan: Apply the same segmentation at legacy campuses with HE-005

threat_event: Student account takeover exposes grades and aid information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credential stuffing against the student portal
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant options for students

threat_event: Lost or stolen staff laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mobile workforce
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Higher Education security and compliance lead 2026-09-08; encryption makes disclosure unlikely

threat_event: SAIG workstation compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Department-provided software on dedicated workstations
treatment_plan: Quarterly configuration review

threat_event: Admissions CRM exposes applicant financial information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Applicant aid estimates in the CRM
treatment_plan: Remove aid estimate fields from the CRM

threat_event: AI proctoring flags lead to unfair academic integrity cases
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flags reviewed inconsistently; camera quality differs
treatment_plan: Written review rule and flag-rate monitoring (P10)

threat_event: Warehouse exfiltration goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress volume alerts on warehouse storage
treatment_plan: Egress alerts (POAM-003)
